name: Autocam Medical
old_description: A global contract manufacturer of orthopedic implants, spinal implants, precision instruments and orthopedic cutting tools.
about:
Autocam Medical, a privately held contract manufacturer, operates its global headquarters from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Kentwood, Michigan, with additional production sites in Plymouth, Massachusetts; Murfreesboro, Tennessee; Warsaw, Indiana; and Suzhou, China. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The firm specializes in high-precision machining of orthopedic and spinal implants, surgical instruments, and cutting tools. Its product range includes surgical drill bits, drivers, screws, plates, and complex handpieces for procedures spanning spine, foot and ankle, hand and wrist, hip and knee, shoulder and elbow, and craniomaxillofacial applications. Core processes comprise CNC milling, turning, and cutter grinding, supported by design-for-manufacturing engineering and proprietary process technology. The Kentwood campus, completed with a $60 million investment, is expected to add 250 jobs as production scales.

Autocam Medical serves original equipment manufacturers in the orthopedic device sector, supplying components for instruments and implants used across major anatomical categories. Customers include companies developing devices for spinal fusion, joint replacement, trauma fixation, and cranial surgery.

The company emphasizes a value-added approach that integrates state-of-the-art equipment with design-for-manufacturing expertise to reduce cost and accelerate time to market for highly engineered surgical components.
